scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a city street with tall buildings on both sides, featuring a mix of residential and commercial properties, including apartments, shops, and restaurants. The street is lined with trees and has a few pedestrians walking along the sidewalk. There are several parked scooters and cars along the curb, and a few streetlights and utility poles are visible. The sky is clear and blue, suggesting a sunny day.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings on either side of the street are primarily residential, with some commercial properties mixed in. They have a mix of modern and older architectural styles, with some featuring balconies and others having flat roofs. Some of the buildings appear to be under construction or renovation.
scene_analysis.materials: The street itself is paved with asphalt, with white lines marking the lanes and crosswalks. There are also several large concrete planters and decorative elements throughout the area.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and tables scattered throughout the area, as well as a few trash cans and recycling bins. A few bicycles are parked along the curb.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees lining the street are mostly bare, suggesting that the area may be experiencing a dry spell. However, there are a few small shrubs and flowers adding some color to the otherwise barren landscape.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs visible, including a large billboard advertising a local business and a smaller sign indicating parking restrictions.
scene_analysis.as_resident: A few locals can be seen going about their daily business, with some stopping to chat or take photos. There are also a few tourists taking photos and admiring the architecture.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: The area is a popular spot for commuters, with several buses and trains passing through the area. There are also several bike paths and pedestrianized zones.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The area is a hub of activity, with many people enjoying the sights and sounds of the city. There are also several street performers and artists adding to the lively atmosphere.
scene_analysis.as_student: The area is home to a diverse range of businesses, including restaurants, cafes, and shops. There are also several student organizations and clubs.
